items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold is defined. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation using recorded telemetry.

The productivity pilot does not establish financial or causal lift. Treatment shipped output was 70 versus 44 for controls, but the treatment cohort also had 58 requests created versus 40, 7 failures versus 7, and a longer average cycle of 12.21 hours versus 9.39; evaluation is empty. Treat output counts as operational activity, not revenue, margin, ROI, or payback evidence. Keep new treatment work deferred until existing measurement and failure gates clear.

Continue only existing repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, measurement, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, AI usage, or shipped-output counts as financial return or causal lift. Retain all growth, SEO, UX, site-factory, experiment, and monetization opportunities as deferred backlog.
